| summarize last_sale = max(event_time), receipts = count() by pharmacy_id, region_name
| extend network_last = toscalar(live_sales | summarize max(event_time))
| extend minutes_behind = datetime_diff('minute', network_last, last_sale)
| project pharmacy_id, region_name, receipts, last_sale, minutes_behind

.create-or-alter function with (folder = "live", docstring = "Branches with no sale for at least threshold_min minutes")
fn_silent_branches(threshold_min: int = 10) {
    live_sales
    | where event_time > ago(1d)
    | summarize last_sale = max(event_time), receipts = count() by pharmacy_id, region_name
    | extend minutes_silent = datetime_diff('minute', now(), last_sale)
    | where minutes_silent >= threshold_min
    | order by minutes_silent desc
}

.create-or-alter function with (folder = "live", docstring = "One row: is the sales feed alive, and how many branches are silent")
fn_feed_health(threshold_min: int = 10) {
    let expected_branches = toscalar(live_sales | where event_time > ago(1d) | summarize dcount(pharmacy_id));
    live_sales
    | where event_time > ago(1d)
    | summarize last_sale = max(event_time) by pharmacy_id
    | summarize feed_last_event = max(last_sale),
                silent_branches = countif(datetime_diff('minute', now(), last_sale) >= threshold_min),
                active_branches = countif(datetime_diff('minute', now(), last_sale) <  threshold_min)
    | extend expected_branches = expected_branches,
             feed_minutes_silent = datetime_diff('minute', now(), feed_last_event)
    | extend status = case(
        feed_minutes_silent >= threshold_min,             "FEED DOWN",
        silent_branches * 2 > expected_branches,         "FEED DEGRADED",
        silent_branches > 0,                             "BRANCH ISSUE",
                                                         "OK")
}
